name: veterinary_clinic_system_066_owner_contact_normalization
instruction: Normalize owner contact data for the SMS gateway: rewrite every owner's phone to E.164-ish digits-only form '+1' followed by the 10 digits (strip punctuation; all seeded numbers are US 10-digit like '(828) 555-0101'), and lowercase every owner's email. Add field contact_normalized='<batch_code>' to every row you change. Rows already compliant keep their values but still get the tag. Do not change names, addresses, or balances.

success_criteria.summary: For each snapshot owner: expected phone '+1'+digits(10), email lower. Assert exact values + tag on ALL 22 rows (all seeded phones have punctuation); assert other fields unchanged; count 22.

checks.expect: For each snapshot owner: expected phone '+1'+digits(10), email lower. Assert exact values + tag on ALL 22 rows (all seeded phones have punctuation); assert other fields unchanged; count 22.
